integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Korean TV drama style, live-action, bright even lighting with clean bright color grading, a medium-wide shot frames a luxurious villa swimming pool on a sunlit afternoon. A young elegant East Asian woman in a red bikini with white polka dots reclines on a white lounge chair beside the water, a wide-brimmed sun hat resting on the grass, her skin with a glossy dewy sheen. Beside her on a matching lounge chair lies a handsome East Asian man in his late twenties wearing loose white linen shorts, bare-chested, sunglasses pushed up on his head. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the young woman turns her head toward him and the cool, composed voice of the woman (S1) says: <d>[Korean] 오빠, 너 요즘 왜 이렇게 안 느끼해?</d> [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a close-up of the man. He smiles slightly and chuckles, and the deep, unhurried voice of the man (S2) replies: <d>[Korean] 내가 금붕어라는 사람을 알게 됐거든.</d> Sunlight glints off the water as he reaches for a glass on the side table. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts back to a medium close-up of the young woman. She raises an eyebrow with a teasing expression and asks hurriedly, the composed voice of the woman (S1) says again: <d>[Korean] 어머, 진짜 신기하다? 빨리 그 사람 전화번호 알려줘.</d> She lifts her sunglasses slightly as the sunny poolside settles and the shot slowly ends.

overall_soundscape: Gentle pool water laps against the edge while a soft breeze rustles the surrounding leaves. A light splash and the clink of a glass on a table accompany the low murmur of the conversation.

non_diegetic_music: A warm Korean-drama OST with soft piano chords and gentle strings at a moderate tempo, carrying a light, hopeful melody.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, realistic domestic short-drama television style, vertical 9:16 framing, a luxury corporate lobby of an empire chaebol group at midday. There are no subtitles, no captions and no on-screen dialogue text anywhere in the video - the only text visible is the golden corporate logo on the background wall. A soaring double-height ceiling, polished cream marble floor, a sweeping marble reception desk and floor-to-ceiling glass windows; on the background wall behind the reception desk a large golden corporate logo with the Chinese characters "林氏集团" gleams brightly. Bright even interior lighting like a polished modern TV drama set, the surfaces gleaming, the colors clean and slightly vibrant with a subtle beauty-filter gloss. A wide establishing shot frames the whole lobby: a handsome young man in a plain rumpled white shirt stands alone in the center, his fists clenched, jaw tight, a defiant look in his eyes, turning to gaze toward the far elevator doors as if waiting. [Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the camera cuts to a close-up of the young man, his eyes fixed on the elevator doors, waiting, a quiet tense stillness in his face. [Shot 3] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of the young heiress stepping out from the elevator, a composed cold beauty in her early twenties wearing an elegant tailored dark haute-couture suit, thin stiletto heels and delicate jewelry, her black hair in a sleek straight style, her skin smooth and luminous under the soft studio light. She tilts her chin up and looks down at him with a contemptuous, mocking gaze, a full glass of water in her hand. The young heiress in a cold, arrogant and slightly drawling voice (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 就凭你这么油腻的穷小子，也配踏入我林氏集团？</d> In one quick forward motion she tips the glass and splashes the water straight across his face, water running down his jaw, as she snaps in the same cold drawl: <d>[Chinese] 好好洗洗吧你！</d> [Shot 4] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of the young man, water dripping from his hair and chin, his wet shirt clinging to his skin, his face unchanged, the same defiant young man. He slowly raises a hand and wipes the water off his face, then lifts his eyes. [Shot 5] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a closer shot of the young man: a faint, cold, contemptuous smirk curls at the corner of his lips, and he fixes his eyes straight on her, speaking in a low, steady, darkly amused voice (S2): <d>[Chinese] 我不但油腻，一致性也不咋地。</d> [Shot 6] At 00:08.700, the camera cuts to a close-up of the heiress, her expression stiffening, caught off guard, a flush of indignation and a flicker of uncertainty crossing her face, as the shot holds on her stunned reaction to the final frame.

overall_soundscape: Crisp high-heeled footsteps echo across the lofty marble lobby, followed by the splash of water hitting skin and fabric, a soft drip of water, and the slow wet sound of a hand wiping across a face, ending in a tense silence.

non_diegetic_music: A low, ominous drone of sustained cello and double bass under a tense, repeating piano ostinato at a slow, brooding tempo - hinting at the heiress's oppressive authority. A sharp percussive stinger hits at the moment the water is flung, then the music eases into a lighter, wry pizzicato string motif that plucks at a loose, comedic bounce, settling into a quiet, unresolved hold as the shot freezes on the heiress's stunned face.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a clean, lightly comedic Chinese-sitcom style with bright clinical lighting and a steady, conversational pace.
[Shot 1] A medium two-shot opens inside <Subject 3>, the consultation room. <Subject 1>, the female doctor from <Picture 1>, sits behind the desk in her white coat with a stethoscope around her neck, casually raises her head to look toward the male patient, and asks in a dry, offhand voice, <d>[Chinese] 哪里不好？</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 2> (S2). He leans forward, hands clasped and resting on the office desk, deadpan and a little weary, and replies in a flat drawl, <d>[Chinese] 都说我太油腻了，我这么年轻为什么会油腻啊？</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts back to a medium close-up of <Subject 1> (S1). She sets down the pen and delivers the punchline in a calm, deadpan clinical tone, <d>[Chinese] 因为你太想要结果了，本来要跑40步，你8步就跑完了，能不油吗。</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a full-bodied wide shot from the side of the room, the doctor looking back at him calmly, while <Subject 2> (S2) blinks in utter confusion and lets out a baffled, <d>[Chinese] 啊？</d> holding the befuddled comedic beat through the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet consultation-room tone with soft HVAC hum and faint paper-handling rustle, rising to a brief burst of canned sitcom laughter after the punchline.

non_diegetic_music:
A light, bouncy comedic underscore with playful pizzicato strings and a plucky bassline at a moderate tempo, staying low under the dialogue and punctuated by a short laugh-track sting at the punchline.
